title: Ellie pad change analysis result (pad_change_v1)
description: Structured answer for one person presence at the tray (US7). Same BEFORE/AFTER crops as the visit analysis. 'reason' is shown to the owner, so it is Brazilian Portuguese.

pad_replaced.description: AFTER shows a different pad than BEFORE (old stains gone, new pad edges/position/colour). Picking up poop or wiping the tray alone is NOT a replacement.

pad_color.description: Colour of the pad in AFTER.

poop_removed.description: Poop visible in BEFORE is gone in AFTER. Stored only (input for future 006).

reason.description: Short explanation in pt-BR, e.g. 'tapete novo: manchas antigas sumiram e bordas mudaram'.
